description_en: Queries the details of access groups in batches
description_zh: 批量查询权限组详细信息
name: ListAccessGroups

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the starting position of the query.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询起始位置。

默认值：1
parameters.name: start_offset

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页返回结果的行数。

默认值：10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the returned results.

Valid values:

CreateTime (default): sorts the results by creation time.
AccessGroupName: sorts the results by access group name
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果排序字段。

取值：

CreateTime（默认值）：按创建时间排序。
AccessGroupName：按权限组名称排序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order of the returned results.

Valid values:

ASC (default): ascending order.
DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果排序方式。

取值：

ASC（默认值）：递增
DESC：递减
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token.

If a single query does not return all results, a non-empty NextToken is returned. You can include the NextToken in the next request to continue the query
parameters.help_zh:
下一页标识。

如果一次查询结果并没有完整返回所有的目录，则返回 NextToken 不为空。您可以在查询中上传正确的 NextToken 继续查询
parameters.name: next_token

AccessGroupId.description_en: The ID of the access group

AccessGroupName.description_en: The name of the access group

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the access group was created. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard. Example: 2022-04-18T08:02:09.986217Z
CreateTime.description_zh: 权限组的创建时间。采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，例如 2022-04-18T08:02:09.986217Z

Description.description_en: The description of the access group

IsDefault.description_en:
Specifies whether the access group is the default access group.

Valid values:

true: The access group is the default access group. A default access group allows access from all IP addresses. You cannot delete a default access group or the rules within it.
false: The access group is not the default access group
IsDefault.description_zh:
权限组是否为用户的默认权限组。

包括：

true：该权限组为默认权限组。当该权限组为默认权限组时，允许所有IP地址访问，且用户无法删除默认权限组及权限组内的权限规则。
false：该权限组不是默认权限组

MountPointCount.description_en: The number of mount points associated with the access group
MountPointCount.description_zh: 权限组关联挂载点的数量

NetworkType.description_en: The network type of the access group

RuleCount.description_en: The number of rules in the access group
RuleCount.description_zh: 权限组中权限规则的数量

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token.

If a single query does not return all results, a non-empty NextToken is returned. You can include the NextToken in the next request to continue the query
NextToken.description_zh:
下一页标识。

如果一次查询结果并没有完整返回所有的目录，则返回 NextToken 不为空。您可以在查询中上传正确的 NextToken 继续查询

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned results
